description: Source code for a script that fetches and analyzes job statuses from a HUD API, classifies failing jobs, and generates alerts for recurrent failures, with command-line argument parsing.

classes.name: JobStatus
classes.description: Class representing the status of a job, including methods to determine current status, failures, flaky jobs, and alert conditions.

methods.name: fetch_hud_data
methods.description: Fetches HUD data from a remote API for a given repository and branch.

methods.name: map_job_data
methods.description: Creates a mapping from job names to their data from the HUD shaGrid.

methods.name: is_job_failed
methods.description: Determines if a job has failed based on its conclusion.

methods.name: is_job_skipped
methods.description: Checks if a job is skipped or neutral.

methods.name: get_failed_jobs
methods.description: Filters a list of jobs to only those that have failed.

methods.name: classify_jobs
methods.description: Classifies jobs into those to alert on and flaky jobs based on their statuses.

methods.name: filter_job_names
methods.description: Filters job names based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: get_recurrently_failing_jobs_alerts
methods.description: Main function to get alerts for recurrent job failures based on repo, branch, and regex.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the script.
